caption: The drawing depicts two objects on a plain, light beige background. The central object is a brown, wooden, goblet-shaped mortar with a wide, flared rim, a narrow middle, and a broader, cylindrical base. The surface shows irregular dark spots and wood grain, indicating texture and material. Above and slightly to the left of the main object, there is a circular, shallow lid or disk, also brown with similar wood grain and dark spots, featuring a cluster of small holes arranged in a circular pattern in the center. There is a small signature "Frank H. Gray" in fine red-brown ink below the main object and slightly to the right. The composition is clean and uncluttered, with the objects rendered realistically and spaced apart on the page.
title: Ink Sander
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
